rules.EMAs: EMA12 alpha2/13, EMA26 alpha2/27; first close seed, adjust=False; EMA=alpha*close+(1-alpha)*previousEMA
rules.signal: EMA9 of MACD, alpha2/10=0.2, seeded with first MACD value; histogram=MACD-signal informational
rules.entry: current MACD>signal AND previous MACD<=previous signal AND close>current-inclusive SMA(close,50). Strict current inequalities, inclusive prior equality; actual crossover event, not all bullish states
rules.exit: current MACD<signal AND previous MACD>=previous signal; no exit trend condition
rules.warmup: full50 observed closes required for entry; first eligible index49. No synthetic firstbar crossover. First-close EMA seeds may influence short histories; no added burn-in beyond requested50bar warmup
rules.execution: completed daily close signal -> next available symbol session open; one long per symbol; entry only if flat, reverse-cross exit only if held; no extra stop/filters
rules.terminal: no forced liquidation; open positions separately marked; last-close entry/exit signals pending and unfilled
rules.portfolio_DD: unavailable: no sizing/capital constraints/mark-to-market portfolio equity model
rules.coverage: same692 current exact-universe Turso stocks; 52 missing and seven stale excluded; no aliases or further Fyers requests
limitations: mixed Turso corporate-action adjustments not independently verified
missing sessions and first-close EMA convergence effects especially on short histories
zero costs and unconstrained concurrent capital limit practical implementability

caveats: Historical closed-trade arithmetic statistics, not portfolio returns. Open trades excluded. No equal-capital sizing, compounding, equity curve, CAGR, or portfolio drawdown.
Gross zero costs; present-day universe survivorship bias; mixed-source corporate-action adjustments and missing sessions remain unverified. Extreme returns are data-sensitive, not recommendations.
